resources.string: Creates and manages an isolated work profile on this device.
Device administrator rights are required so this app can act as profile owner of the new, isolated work profile.
Creates a separate managed profile with its own storage, contacts and app space. The primary user is never modified.
No work profile owned by this app exists on the device.
The provisioning intent requires this app to be an active device admin in the primary user first.
The system setup flow is running. Do not leave the device.
Profile owner of “%1$s”. Storage, contacts and apps are fully isolated from the primary user.
This device is already managed by %1$s. Only one work profile can exist per device — remove the existing one first.
Inside a profile, but not profile owner
Removes this app as profile owner. The profile itself stays until you delete it in Settings → Passwords & accounts → Work profile → Remove work profile.
Device admin not granted — provisioning cannot start.
No system activity handles this intent. See the adb fallback.
